verdict.rationale: Column documents API-driven ACH origination for both credits (push) and debits (pull), built on its own direct Federal Reserve integration. It also offers sandbox endpoints to simulate incoming ACH credits and debits, and general-purpose webhooks for platform events. However, the pack never mentions same-day ACH windows or returns, NOCs, or reversals as modeled objects with dedicated webhook events, which is half the story. Missing for 10: evidence of same-day ACH windows, first-class return/NOC/reversal objects, ACH-specific webhook events for the unhappy paths, independent hands-on corroboration.
